title: Astra Data Factory source config, version 0
description: One versioned instance of a Source Spec mapped to a canonical model under a Target Profile, with rules, DQ rules and resolution parameters (product spec Section 4). Version 0 fixes identity, ownership, references and mappings; the compiler (S3.1.1) resolves every reference and checks mapping types.

config_version.description: Schema version this file is written against.

id.description: Unique source id; the file must be named <id>.yaml.

family.description: Layout family assigned by the Pattern Matcher.

id.description: Source Spec id in the spec registry.

pattern.description: Pattern library id that parses the spec (fixed_width_multi_record, delimited_file). Optional: the first pattern that handles the spec is used when absent.

target_profile.description: A target profile the factory has renderers for (snowflake_iceberg).

domain_pack.description: A domain pack under domains/; its latest canonical model is the target.

effective_from.description: Business date from which this config is in force.

source.description: Field name of the spec's logical record, as the spec names it

record.description: Logical record of the spec the field belongs to; required when the spec has more than one.

transform.description: A transform call, name(arguments), from the vocabulary the renderers implement (signed_implied_decimal, implied_decimal, negate, trim, upper, to_date, nullif).

rule.description: Rule catalog id that governs this mapping; must be listed under rules.

rules.description: Ids of rule catalog entries (rules/<group>/<name>.yaml) this config depends on. A mapping's rule must be listed here; the catalog says what each rule is, who owns it and its status.

resolution.description: Resolution parameters (account, security, transaction code, price). Free-form in version 0.

delivery.description: When the custodian delivers and which files are expected every business day. Drives the 'late' alert (S1.2.4). Shared by every source of the same custodian; sources must agree.

refresh_expected_every_days.description: A full refresh file is expected at least this often; when none has been merged for longer, a refresh_stale alert is raised at the custodian's late severity.

pattern.description: SQL LIKE pattern of the file path relative to the landing prefix, for example pershing/GCUS_%_POS_%.dat

alerts.description: Alert severity for this custodian. Both default to error.

late.description: Severity of the alert raised when expected files are missing after the cutoff

task_failure.description: Severity of the alert raised when one of the custodian's tasks fails
